user.title: New venue
user.description: Kydax Bootstrap installs and configures everything a venue needs: the Kydax integrations, the customer dashboard and its lock. Start from a bundle exported from a reference venue, or from the built-in template.

bundle_file.title: Bundle file
bundle_file.description: Upload the venue bundle (JSON) exported from Kydax Bootstrap on the reference venue.

site_sound.title: Sound — Symetrix
site_sound.description: The Symetrix Jupiter address for this venue. Leave the address empty if this venue has no sound system.

site_light.title: Lights — brightness source
site_light.description: The outdoor brightness source used to drive the dimming.

data.skip_light: This venue has no managed lights

light_map.title: Lights — mapping
light_map.description: Match every light of the reference venue with the equivalent light here. Unmatched lights are dropped.

light_pick.title: Lights — selection
light_pick.description: Pick the lights to manage. Day 90%, evening 30%, night 0% by default; adjust later in Kydax Light.

switches.title: Customer switches
switches.description: A customer switch pauses music channels and/or freezes lights (e.g. « Terrasse »). Leave the name empty to add none.

birthdays.title: Birthdays and events
birthdays.description: Each event triggers a Symetrix preset (e.g. the birthday song), optionally for a fixed duration before returning to another preset. Leave the name empty to add none.

dashboard.title: Customer dashboard
dashboard.description: The locked dashboard shown to the staff. The kiosk lock hides the header and sidebar for non-administrators.

confirm.title: Ready to provision
confirm.description: {components} component(s) to install, {channels} sound channel(s), {lights} light(s), {events} event(s). Provisioning downloads the components from GitHub, restarts Home Assistant, creates the Kydax configurations and builds the dashboard.

error.invalid_file: This file is not a valid bundle
error.invalid_version: This bundle version is not supported
error.invalid_components: The bundle's component list is invalid
error.invalid_dashboard: The bundle's dashboard section is invalid
error.source_entity_required: Pick the entity matching the chosen source type

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only one Kydax Bootstrap instance is possible.

provision.title: Provision
provision.description: Applies the current bundle: installs missing components (with a restart if needed), creates or updates the Kydax configurations and rebuilds the dashboard. Progress is on the Kydax Bootstrap status sensor.

import.title: Import a bundle
import.description: Replaces the stored bundle. Use « Provision now » afterwards to apply it.

error.invalid_dashboard: The bundle's dashboard section is invalid
